title: Cohen's and quadratic-weighted kappa for two raters
summary: Chance-corrected agreement between two raters on an ordinal scale, unweighted and with quadratic weights, with large-sample standard errors.

sizing._why: Kappa sample size depends on the category prevalences and the kappa to rule out; no catalog form takes them.

pinned_defaults: R: irr::kappa2 with weight = 'unweighted' and weight = 'squared' (quadratic weights 1 - (i - j)^2 / (k - 1)^2); Python: written out.
SE: Fleiss, Cohen and Everitt (1969) large-sample variance, written out in both (irr reports only a test of kappa = 0).
_ordinal: On an ordinal scale unweighted kappa counts a one-grade disagreement like a three-grade one: 0.33 against 0.67 weighted here. Percent agreement (0.51) is not chance-corrected.
